# Publish gate report

**Going out:** landing page hero, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience.

**Claims**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Packed by hand in Bristol | On the policy list ("every tin is packed by hand in Bristol") |
| Certified organic by the Soil Association | On the policy list |
| Free UK delivery on orders over £25 | On the policy list |
| Loose leaf tea | Product fact, fine as written |

All three claims match the policy wording and nothing is invented. No evidence-log rows are needed because every claim is already on the policy list.

**Regulated claims:** "Certified organic" is an environmental-type claim, but it is specific, tied to a named certifier and on the policy list. The delivery offer is a real, unconditional threshold with no countdown or urgency. No health, money or children's claims. Pass.

**House style:** There is no voice section in the policy, so I checked only for AI tells and clarity. There are no stock openers, intensifiers or slogan closers. The one weakness is repetition: "packed by hand in Bristol" appears twice in three short sentences.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own page, with no sponsor, affiliate link, gifted product, endorsement or AI-generated imagery in the copy. No label needed.

**Suggested edit (optional, claims unchanged):**
> Loose leaf tea, certified organic by the Soil Association and packed by hand in Bristol. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

**Needs a decision:**
- Do you want the tightened version above or the original? Either passes the claims checks.
- The policy names no approver for this kind of content. Please confirm who is approving, and give an explicit yes to the exact final wording. I haven't recorded any approval.
